event_headline: Trump Administration Requires 780,000+ Temporary Visa Holders to Leave US to Apply for Green Cards
topic: Immigration Policy: Open Borders vs. National Control and Cultural Preservation

chronology.action: Announced new immigration policy requiring all immigrants in US on temporary visas (students, H-1B workers, tourists) who want to apply for green card to leave the US first; affects 780,000+ immigrants
Forcibly removed 17 asylum seekers (Turks, Afghans, Iranians) to Central African Republic under 'third country removals' policy
Launched legal challenge to Trump's efforts restricting birthright citizenship for infants born in the US

key_actors.name: Trump Administration
key_actors.role: Executive authority implementing immigration policy changes
key_actors.stated_position: Requiring temporary visa holders to leave US to apply for green cards; restricting birthright citizenship

key_actors.name: Tom Homan (ICE official)
key_actors.stated_position: Celebrates ICE arrest records as historic highs; dismisses civil liberties concerns about vehicle stop policy changes

key_actors.name: Rights organizations
key_actors.stated_position: Opposing birthright citizenship restrictions through legal action

factual_claims.claim: 780,000+ immigrants in the US on temporary visas are affected by new green card application requirement to leave the country
US forcibly removed 17 people (Turks, Afghans, Iranians) to Central African Republic on June 12, 2026
ICE arrest records reached historic highs under current administration
H-1B visa holders number in hundreds of thousands potentially subject to deportation demands

verified_facts.claim: 780,000+ immigrants in the US on temporary visas are affected by new green card application requirement to leave the country
verified_facts.finding: The search results provided contain no information about immigration policy, green card applications, temporary visas, or any requirements for immigrants to leave the United States. All results are unrelated Microsoft support documentation about Hotmail, Windows, Outlook, and Exchange Server.

verified_facts.claim: US forcibly removed 17 people (Turks, Afghans, Iranians) to Central African Republic on June 12, 2026
verified_facts.finding: The search results contain no information about the claimed deportation event. The results only show general pages about US states, travel visas, the State Department homepage, and unrelated topics like a 2019 film and celebrity news. None address deportations, removals, or the Central African Republic on June 12, 2026.

verified_facts.claim: ICE arrest records reached historic highs under current administration
verified_facts.finding: The search results do not contain any information about ICE arrest records or statistics under any administration. The results include general information about ice (frozen water), the Institution of Civil Engineers, and basic ICE agency pages, but no data on arrest numbers or trends.

verified_facts.claim: H-1B visa holders number in hundreds of thousands potentially subject to deportation demands
verified_facts.finding: The search results contain no information about H-1B visas, visa holders, deportation policies, or immigration matters. All results relate only to the letter 'H' in the alphabet, its pronunciation, etymology, and usage in various contexts (music, chemistry, linguistics).

disputed_claims.claim: H-1B visa holders and their families should be deported because 'their idols and customs clash with our towns' and 'they burn our churches and synagogues'
